peer_identity.arc_label: Othon's passionate son—from council defiance to crippled warrior to mourned dead
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Passionate and confrontational voice; equates glorious death with honor. Equestrian bond (Shazam the horse). Physically disabled from broken legs. Capable of genuine remorse and reconciliation with father. Deceased before vol04 events; present as object of mourning and inheritance reference only in later records.
peer_identity.rationale: All four Bari records describe the same person: Othon's son. Vol01 shows him as infant/young defender; vol02 as crippled, volatile young adult who reconciles with Othon; vol03 as deceased mourned by Othon; vol04 as the 'faithful servant' whose daughters and horse remain with Othon—a post-death reference to the same figure. The vol04 designation 'faithful servant' is a translation artifact; the text describes Bari's daughters and horse, confirming the same person. No contradictory facts.
